answer_1.quote: We evaluate the proposed Value-based CaliBration (VCB) method on two popular generation datasets, AnthropicHH dialogue and Reddit TL;DR summarization.

answer_2.quote: Following previous studies, this paper employs three different evaluation metrics: (1) Using a public reward model to obtain rewards for each response and calculating the win rate of our method compared to the baselines. (2) Employing GPT-4 as a proxy for human evaluation of the generation quality.

answer_3.quote: Employing GPT-4 as a proxy for human evaluation of the generation quality. Therefore, we design different prompts for each task, enabling GPT-4 to judge whether the responses generated by our method are better, worse, or tied compared to the baselines.

answer_4.quote: Then, we hire two Ph.D. students as annotators, hide the method names, and ask them which response is more helpful and harmless.
answer_4.guideline: ask them which response is more helpful and harmless
